remarks: Forget the ordinary colonial floor plan—this custom home was designed for the way people actually live today.The main level is made for gathering. Open living and entertaining spaces flow effortlessly from the chef's kitchen to the great room, creating the perfect setting for everything from holiday celebrations to quiet evenings at home. A sun-filled studio with its own covered portico offers an inspiring place to work remotely, create, paint, practice yoga, or simply enjoy a peaceful morning overlooking the landscape. Step outside to one of the home's greatest surprises. Perched above picturesque Mud Creek, the expansive deck becomes your private retreat for morning coffee and year-round wildlife watching. Upstairs, the home transforms into a true sanctuary. The thoughtfully designed bedroom layout provides exceptional privacy, while the luxurious primary suite features an oversized walk-in closet, private flex room, and balcony overlooking the quiet cul-de-sac. Then there's the garage! More than a place to park, the heated three-car garage becomes an adventure zone with its built-in climbing wall, workshop space, and room for hobbies, fitness, projects, or storage. Quality details throughout include some KitchenAid appliances, butler pantry, walk-in pantry, custom window treatments, zoned heating and cooling, security system, backup sump battery, generator wiring, and numerous thoughtful updates. This isn't just another home : It's a place to entertain, create, recharge, and enjoy every season.
